sentences.en: We get support from UC Davis, a globally ranked university working to solve the world's most pressing problems in food, energy, health, education, and the environment.
sentences.zh: 我们得到了加州大学戴维斯分校的支持，这是一所全球排名的大学，致力于解决世界在食品、能源、健康、教育和环境方面最紧迫的问题。

sentences.en: UC Davis researchers collaborate and innovate in California and around the globe to find transformational solutions.
sentences.zh: 加州大学戴维斯分校的研究人员在加州乃至全球范围内开展合作与创新，以寻找变革性的解决方案。

sentences.en: It's all part of the university's mission to promote quality of life for all living things.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是该大学促进所有生物生活质量这一使命的一部分。

sentences.en: Find out more at 21stCentury.UCDavis.edu.
sentences.zh: 欲了解更多信息，请访问 21stCentury.UCDavis.edu。

sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: Here's the Baltimore City-County line.
sentences.zh: 这是巴尔的摩市与县的边界线。

sentences.en: Weapons in the arsenal of exclusion.
sentences.zh: 排斥武器库中的武器。

sentences.en: Alphabetical.
sentences.zh: 按字母顺序排列。

sentences.en: Armrests on benches.
sentences.zh: 长椅上的扶手。

sentences.en: Blood relative ordinance.
sentences.zh: 血亲条例。

sentences.en: Blockbusting.
sentences.zh: 街区破坏（指通过制造恐慌促使白人低价卖房的手段）。

sentences.en: Bouncer.
sentences.zh: 保镖。

sentences.en: Cul-de-sac.
sentences.zh: 死胡同。

sentences.en: I think cities are great.
sentences.zh: 我认为城市很棒。

sentences.en: There's movement and activity and diversity.
sentences.zh: 这里有流动、活动和多样性。

sentences.en: But go to any city and it's pretty clear a place can be diverse without really being integrated.
sentences.zh: 但你去任何城市看看，很明显，一个地方可以具有多样性，却并不真正融合。

sentences.en: Cities exist to bring people together, but cities can also keep people apart.
sentences.zh: 城市存在的意义是把人们聚在一起，但城市也可以把人们隔离开来。

sentences.en: That's Daniel Diocco.
sentences.zh: 那是丹尼尔·迪奥科。

sentences.en: My name is Daniel Diocco and I am an urban planner.
sentences.zh: 我叫丹尼尔·迪奥科，我是一名城市规划师。

sentences.en: I have a company in New York called Interboro Partners.
sentences.zh: 我在纽约有一家公司，叫 Interboro Partners。

sentences.en: Over the last few years, Daniel and his two colleagues at Interboro Partners.
sentences.zh: 在过去的几年里，丹尼尔和他在 Interboro Partners 的两位同事。

sentences.en: Interboro Partners is myself, Georgine Theodore, and Tobias Armbrose.
sentences.zh: Interboro Partners 的成员是我、乔治娜·西奥多和托拜厄斯·阿姆布罗斯。

sentences.en: And the three of us have been working on this project for a number of years called the Arsenal of Exclusion and Inclusion.
sentences.zh: 我们三个人多年来一直致力于一个名为“排斥与包容武器库”的项目。

sentences.en: This arsenal is a catalog of stuff inside a city.
sentences.zh: 这个武器库是城市中各种事物的目录。

sentences.en: What we call weapons.
sentences.zh: 我们称之为武器的东西。

sentences.en: Concierge.
sentences.zh: 礼宾服务。

sentences.en: Explosive zoning.
sentences.zh: 爆炸性分区。

sentences.en: Fire hydrant.
sentences.zh: 消防栓。

sentences.en: Food truck ordinance.
sentences.zh: 餐车条例。

sentences.en: That architects, planners, policy makers, developers, etc.
sentences.zh: 建筑师、规划师、政策制定者、开发商等。

sentences.en: use to either bring people together or keep people apart.
sentences.zh: 利用这些手段要么把人们聚在一起，要么把人们隔离开来。

sentences.en: Or open the city or close the city.
sentences.zh: 或者开放城市，或者封闭城市。

sentences.en: Or increase access to space or restrict people's access to space.
sentences.zh: 或者增加人们对空间的获取，或者限制人们对空间的获取。

sentences.en: Any number of ways to spin it.
sentences.zh: 有无数种解读方式。

sentences.en: Historic Preservation.
sentences.zh: 历史保护。

sentences.en: Homeowners Association.
sentences.zh: 业主协会。

sentences.en: Weapons ranging from no loitering signs to big things like housing vouchers and exclusionary zoning and all that kind of stuff.
sentences.zh: 武器范围从“禁止游荡”的标志到住房券和排他性分区等大型手段，以及所有类似的东西。

sentences.en: Today we're only going to focus on the Arsenal of Exclusion.
sentences.zh: 今天我们只关注“排斥武器库”。

sentences.en: The weapons that keep people apart.
sentences.zh: 那些让人们彼此隔离的武器。

sentences.en: Weapons in the Arsenal of Exclusion.
sentences.zh: 排斥武器库中的武器。

sentences.en: In the city of Baltimore, a place Daniel Diocco truly loves.
sentences.zh: 在巴尔的摩市，一个丹尼尔·迪奥科真心热爱的地方。

sentences.en: I taught at Maryland Institute College of Art for six years.
sentences.zh: 我在马里兰艺术学院教了六年书。

sentences.en: So I have a strong connection with Baltimore.
sentences.zh: 所以我与巴尔的摩有着深厚的联系。

sentences.en: It's still a city that I love and admire very much.
sentences.zh: 它仍然是我非常热爱和钦佩的城市。

sentences.en: It's a wonderful place.
sentences.zh: 这是一个美妙的地方。

sentences.en: But it's a city that has been honing its arsenal of exclusion for decades.
sentences.zh: 但几十年来，这座城市一直在磨练其排斥武器库。

sentences.en: Baltimore was once to the invisible wall building industry what Detroit was to the automotive industry.
sentences.zh: 巴尔的摩曾经在隐形墙建设行业中的地位，就如同底特律在汽车工业中的地位一样。

sentences.en: An innovative workshop where creative minds work to think up, invent, test out, and ultimately export methods of exclusion.
sentences.zh: 一个创新的工坊，创意人才在这里思考、发明、测试并最终输出排斥方法。

sentences.en: Our producer and resident Baltimorean Sam Greenspan went to look at some of Charm City's exclusive offerings.
sentences.zh: 我们的制片人兼巴尔的摩居民萨姆·格林斯潘去看了看这座“魅力之城”的一些排他性产品。

sentences.en: So the best way to get there is...
sentences.zh: 所以去那里的最好方法是……

sentences.en: Oh, sorry.
sentences.zh: 哦，抱歉。

sentences.en: Okay, so why don't you say where we're going to go and what we're doing and where we're going to go and how we're going to get there.
sentences.zh: 好吧，那你为什么不说说我们要去哪里，我们要做什么，我们要去哪里，以及我们要怎么去那里。

sentences.en: Give me a second.
sentences.zh: 给我一秒钟。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 没问题。

sentences.en: Dan Diocco and I are driving north up Greenmount Avenue in East Baltimore.
sentences.zh: 丹·迪奥科和我正开车沿着巴尔的摩东部的格林蒙特大道向北行驶。

sentences.en: I kind of think of Greenmount North of 33rd, all the way up to Cold Spring as a kind of museum of exclusion.
sentences.zh: 我把第33街以北、一直到冷泉路的那段格林蒙特大道看作是一个排斥博物馆。

sentences.en: So as you're driving north on Greenmount Avenue, north of 33rd Street, it's clear that Greenmount Avenue is a dividing line between rich and poor and black and white.
sentences.zh: 所以当你沿着格林蒙特大道向北行驶，在第33街以北时，很明显格林蒙特大道是贫富之间、黑白之间的分界线。

sentences.en: But what's not immediately obvious is why.
sentences.zh: 但并不显而易见的是原因。

sentences.en: Just to give you a sense, as we drive north on Greenmount, to our right on the east side is Waverly.
sentences.zh: 为了让你有个概念，当我们沿着格林蒙特向北行驶时，右侧东边是韦弗利区。

sentences.en: Waverly is lower income and around 80% African-American.
sentences.zh: 韦弗利区收入较低，约80%是非裔美国人。

sentences.en: 16% have a bachelor's degree.
sentences.zh: 16%的人拥有学士学位。

sentences.en: Median income is $40,000.
sentences.zh: 中位数收入为4万美元。

sentences.en: And on the other side...
sentences.zh: 而在另一边……

sentences.en: On the west side to our left is Oakenshaw and then Guilford, a little to the north of that.
sentences.zh: 西边也就是我们的左侧是奥肯肖，再往北一点是吉尔福德。

sentences.en: A really affluent area buffered by a middle income area.
sentences.zh: 一个非常富裕的地区，由一个中等收入地区作为缓冲。

sentences.en: Only about 7% African-American.
sentences.zh: 只有约7%是非裔美国人。

sentences.en: 75% have a bachelor's degree and the median income is $75,000.
sentences.zh: 75%的人拥有学士学位，中位数收入为7.5万美元。

sentences.en: In Daniel Diocco's view, it's not the wide Greenmount Avenue that keeps these neighborhoods apart.
sentences.zh: 在丹尼尔·迪奥科看来，并不是宽阔的格林蒙特大道让这些社区隔离开来。

sentences.en: It's actually the small and subtle and invisible, yet totally intentional things that keep these neighborhoods separate.
sentences.zh: 实际上是那些微小、微妙、隐形，却完全是有意为之的事物让这些社区保持分离。

sentences.en: Demographically, the divide is very strict and severe.
sentences.zh: 从人口统计学上讲，这种鸿沟非常严格和严重。

sentences.en: You can just see all these physical measures that are deployed to keep people from getting from one side to the other.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到所有这些被部署的物理措施，旨在阻止人们从一边走到另一边。

sentences.en: Just crossing Greenmount on foot is annoying.
sentences.zh: 光是步行穿过格林蒙特大道就很烦人。

sentences.en: Two crosswalks in that 1.25-mile stretch.
sentences.zh: 在那1.25英里的路段上只有两个斑马线。

sentences.en: But what's more interesting is when we talk about the grid.
sentences.zh: 但更有趣的是当我们谈论网格时。

sentences.en: Grid.
sentences.zh: 网格。

sentences.en: Greenmount is where the grid ends.
sentences.zh: 格林蒙特是网格结束的地方。

sentences.en: The grid is there in Waverly on the east side.
sentences.zh: 网格就在东边的韦弗利区。

sentences.en: Notice that on the right, there's the grid, right?
sentences.zh: 注意到右边有网格了吧？

sentences.en: There's 37th Street, 38th Street.
sentences.zh: 那是第37街，第38街。

sentences.en: We can make a right into Waverly, no problem.
sentences.zh: 我们可以右转进入韦弗利，没问题。

sentences.en: But on our left, there's no grid, right?
sentences.zh: 但在我们的左边，没有网格，对吧？

sentences.en: It stops.
sentences.zh: 它停止了。

sentences.en: You'll notice we're heading north now.
sentences.zh: 你会注意到我们现在正向北行驶。

sentences.en: If we try to make a left, we're going to be confronted with dead-end streets, bollards.
sentences.zh: 如果我们试图左转，就会遇到死胡同和护柱。

sentences.en: What is a bollard?
sentences.zh: 什么是护柱？

sentences.en: They're like these security poles that you kind of stick in the ground.
sentences.zh: 它们就像是那种插在地里的安全柱子。

sentences.en: Oh, here's a wall, right?
sentences.zh: 哦，这儿有一堵墙，对吧？

sentences.en: There's this long row of middle-income houses on the west side of the street.
sentences.zh: 街道西侧有一长排中等收入的房子。

sentences.en: They're kind of a buffer against the really wealthy Guilford stuff that's just behind.
sentences.zh: 它们算是对后面那些真正富裕的吉尔福德区域的一种缓冲。

sentences.en: Almost all of the roads dead end the houses.
sentences.zh: 几乎所有的道路都在房子处成了死胡同。

sentences.en: And the few streets that do go through are mostly one-way streets coming the opposite direction out onto Greenmount.
sentences.zh: 而少数几条通行的街道大多是单行道，从相反方向通往格林蒙特大道。

sentences.en: There's no way for us to get left into Oakenshaw or Guilford.
sentences.zh: 我们没有办法左转进入奥肯肖或吉尔福德。

sentences.en: There has to be some way to get into the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 总得有办法进入那个社区吧。

sentences.en: Well, there is, but on Guilford's east side, you really have to go out of your way to find a street that will let you in.
sentences.zh: 嗯，确实有，但在吉尔福德的东侧，你真的得绕远路才能找到一条能让你进去的街道。

sentences.en: So now we're in Guilford, finally.
sentences.zh: 所以现在我们终于在吉尔福德了。

sentences.en: And then once you're inside, you'll notice two things.
sentences.zh: 一旦你进入里面，你会注意到两件事。

sentences.en: The houses are super nice and the roads are super weird.
sentences.zh: 房子超级漂亮，道路超级奇怪。

sentences.en: The roads are windy and they feel disproportionately small next to these houses' giant lawns.
sentences.zh: 道路蜿蜒曲折，在这些房子巨大的草坪旁显得不成比例地狭窄。

sentences.en: And you need a permit to park here.
sentences.zh: 而且在这里停车需要许可证。

sentences.en: Another interesting one is residential parking permits.
sentences.zh: 另一个有趣的例子是居民停车许可证。

sentences.en: Residential parking permit.
sentences.zh: 居民停车许可证。

sentences.en: In case you're wondering, you do not need a permit to park in the less affluent Waverly neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 如果你想知道的话，在收入较低的韦弗利社区停车是不需要许可证的。

sentences.en: But back to Guilford.
sentences.zh: 但回到吉尔福德。

sentences.en: The weirdest thing about these roads is that it's hard to know what direction you're going.
sentences.zh: 这些道路最奇怪的地方在于，你很难知道自己正朝哪个方向走。

sentences.en: And could you tell if we're east, north, west, or south?
sentences.zh: 你能分辨出我们是在向东、向北、向西还是向南吗？

sentences.en: It's really hard to tell, right?
sentences.zh: 真的很难分辨，对吧？

sentences.en: I would imagine we're going south.
sentences.zh: 我想我们是在向南走。

sentences.en: Why not?
sentences.zh: 为什么不呢？

sentences.en: We're actually going eaSt.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上是在向东走。

sentences.en: So this is Greenmount Avenue.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是格林蒙特大道。

sentences.en: Since we're outsiders and we don't know our way around Guilford,
sentences.zh: 因为我们是外来者，不熟悉吉尔福德的路况，

sentences.en: we were shunted out of the neighborhood on a one-way street back out onto Greenmount Avenue.
sentences.zh: 我们被一条单行道引出了社区，回到了格林蒙特大道上。

sentences.en: So this is one of the one-way streets heading out of the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是通往社区外的一条单行道。

sentences.en: Oh my gosh.
sentences.zh: 我的天哪。

sentences.en: So we really got out back to Greenmount and I thought we were going through it.
sentences.zh: 我们真的回到了格林蒙特，我还以为我们能穿过去呢。

sentences.en: These physical barriers in the arsenal of exclusion grids and one-way streets are not that big a deal.
sentences.zh: 这些排斥武器库中的物理屏障——网格和单行道——并不是什么大不了的事。

sentences.en: They're not that hard to overcome.
sentences.zh: 它们并不难克服。

sentences.en: But their placement has meaning.
sentences.zh: 但它们的放置是有意义的。

sentences.en: Does it really matter that you can't make a left turn into Guilford?
sentences.zh: 不能左转进入吉尔福德真的有那么重要吗？

sentences.en: Would this be a more equitable city if we could make that left turn?
sentences.zh: 如果我们能左转，这座城市会变得更公平吗？

sentences.en: Probably not, right?
sentences.zh: 可能不会，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, it's more a symbolic thing, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这更多是一种象征性的东西，对吧？

sentences.en: It's this place where this demographic divide is just rendered very physically in space.
sentences.zh: 这是一个人口鸿沟在空间上被非常物理化地呈现出来的地方。

sentences.en: But it's worth noting that other weapons in the arsenal of exclusion that once existed here in Guilford are now illegal,
sentences.zh: 但值得注意的是，曾经存在于吉尔福德的排斥武器库中的其他武器现在已经非法了，

sentences.en: like restrictive housing covenants.
sentences.zh: 比如限制性住房契约。

sentences.en: Basically, there were housing ordinances that said black people can't live here.
sentences.zh: 基本上，当时有住房条例规定黑人不能住在这里。

sentences.en: Restrictive housing covenants.
sentences.zh: 限制性住房契约。

sentences.en: Deoka says that this neighborhood actually pioneered the use of segregationist covenants,
sentences.zh: 迪奥科说，这个社区实际上率先使用了种族隔离契约，

sentences.en: housing deeds that restricted occupancy to only white people.
sentences.zh: 即限制仅限白人居住的住房契约。

sentences.en: This wasn't illegal until 1968.
sentences.zh: 这直到1968年才被定为非法。

sentences.en: You can point at these gridless streets as being an emblem of the racial segregation that still exists in Baltimore.
sentences.zh: 你可以指出这些没有网格的街道是巴尔的摩至今仍存在的种族隔离的象征。

sentences.en: With good cause.
sentences.zh: 这很有道理。

sentences.en: But it's interesting to speculate what the neighborhood would be like if these exclusionary measures weren't in place.
sentences.zh: 但推测一下，如果这些排斥性措施不存在，这个社区会是什么样子，这很有趣。

sentences.en: Had this neighborhood been built on a grid, upper middle class white people living here,
sentences.zh: 如果这个社区是建立在网格上的，住在这里的中上层白人，

sentences.en: probably would have fled to the suburbs in the 70s, 80s, right?
sentences.zh: 可能在70年代、80年代就会逃往郊区了，对吧？

sentences.en: Given that there are rich white people still living here within the city limits paying city taxes,
sentences.zh: 鉴于现在仍有富有的白人住在城市范围内并缴纳城市税，

sentences.en: is it worse than just having all of the rich white people living out in the county?
sentences.zh: 这是否比让所有富有的白人都住在县里要好？

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, it's a really good question.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我的意思是，这是一个非常好的问题。

sentences.en: And the trick is to try to develop neighborhood change.
sentences.zh: 诀窍在于尝试推动社区变革。

sentences.en: And that's not a zero-sum game where one party loses and another party gains.
sentences.zh: 而且这不是一个一方输、一方赢的零和博弈。

sentences.en: And that is Interborough Partners' next project, creating development solutions that are not zero-sum games.
sentences.zh: 而这正是 Interboro Partners 的下一个项目，创造非零和博弈的发展解决方案。

sentences.en: But it all starts with labeling and categorizing the weapons in the arsenal of exclusion and inclusion
sentences.zh: 但这始于对排斥与包容武器库中的武器进行标记和分类，

sentences.en: so we can figure out how to create cities that are more open to everybody.
sentences.zh: 这样我们才能找出如何创造对所有人更开放的城市。

sentences.en: Here's a little end note.
sentences.zh: 这里有一个小小的结语。

sentences.en: Most of the weapons in the arsenal of exclusion create barriers that are hard to see
sentences.zh: 排斥武器库中的大多数武器制造的障碍很难被发现，

sentences.en: because they are subtle and nondescript, except when they're not.
sentences.zh: 因为它们微妙且平淡无奇，除非它们不是这样。

sentences.en: Here's the Baltimore City-County line.
sentences.zh: 这是巴尔的摩市与县的边界线。

sentences.en: Dan Diocca took Sam to the former site of Hollander Ridge.
sentences.zh: 丹·迪奥科带萨姆去了霍兰德岭的旧址。

sentences.en: It was a lower-income housing project built way out on the City-County line.
sentences.zh: 那是一个建在市县边界线上的低收入住房项目。

sentences.en: It has since been torn down, but one artifact of the project remains.
sentences.zh: 虽然它后来被拆除了，但该项目仍留下了一件遗物。

sentences.en: The Rosedale community up there lobbied to build this 8-foot-tall, spiked, wrought-iron fence
sentences.zh: 那里的罗斯代尔社区游说建造了这道8英尺高、带尖刺的锻铁栅栏，

sentences.en: around the perimeter of Hollander Ridge to separate it from their community,
sentences.zh: 环绕在霍兰德岭的周边，将其与他们的社区隔离开来，

sentences.en: which then was predominantly white suburban community.
sentences.zh: 当时那是一个以白人为主的郊区社区。

sentences.en: It's like a gated community created from the outside, you know?
sentences.zh: 这就像是从外部建立起来的封闭式社区，你懂吗？

sentences.en: It's a really strange and unfortunate thing.
sentences.zh: 这真是一件既奇怪又不幸的事情。

sentences.en: It's funny that the spikes are actually pointing the other direction.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，这些尖刺实际上是指向另一个方向的。

sentences.en: That's true.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: So I guess you could go over, but you couldn't get back.
sentences.zh: 所以我猜你可以翻过去，但却回不来。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible was produced this week by Sam Greenspan and me, Roman Mars,
sentences.zh: 本周的《99% Invisible》由萨姆·格林斯潘和我，罗曼·马尔斯制作，

sentences.en: with help from Scott Goldberg.
sentences.zh: 并得到了斯科特·戈德堡的帮助。

sentences.en: We are a project of KALW 91.7 Local Public Radio in San Francisco
sentences.zh: 我们是旧金山KALW 91.7地方公共广播电台的一个项目，

sentences.en: and the American Institute of Architects in San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 同时也隶属于旧金山美国建筑师协会。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible is distributed by PRX, the public radio exchange,
sentences.zh: 《99% Invisible》由公共广播交换平台PRX发行，

sentences.en: making public radio more public, at prx.org.
sentences.zh: 让公共广播更加大众化，详情请访问prx.org。

sentences.en: Support for 99% Invisible is provided in part by tiny letter, email for people with something to say.
sentences.zh: 《99% Invisible》的部分支持来自Tiny Letter，专为有话要说的人提供的电子邮件服务。

sentences.en: My boy Carver always has something to say.
sentences.zh: 我的孩子卡弗总是有话要说。

sentences.en: What do you have to say, Carver?
sentences.zh: 你想说什么，卡弗？

sentences.en: Every year, the volcano is squirted out in lava.
sentences.zh: 每年，火山都会喷发出熔岩。

sentences.en: Every year.
sentences.zh: 每年都是。

sentences.en: Shh!
sentences.zh: 嘘！

sentences.en: Squirted out lava.
sentences.zh: 喷出熔岩。

sentences.en: But it's not that close to us, so it doesn't kill us.
sentences.zh: 但它离我们不近，所以不会伤害到我们。

sentences.en: It only kills the people that live really close to it.
sentences.zh: 它只会伤害那些住得离它非常近的人。

sentences.en: Just tell the people who are close to it,
sentences.zh: 只要告诉那些住得近的人，

sentences.en: stay away, get out of your houses,
sentences.zh: 离远点，离开你们的房子，

sentences.en: so they don't get killed by the volcano.
sentences.zh: 这样他们就不会被火山伤害了。

sentences.en: Now that's a reason to send a newsletter.
sentences.zh: 这倒是个发送通讯的好理由。

sentences.en: Maybe even a follow-up phone call.
sentences.zh: 甚至可能还需要打个后续电话。

sentences.en: Tiny Letter, the simplest way to send an email newsletter.
sentences.zh: Tiny Letter，发送电子邮件通讯最简单的方式。

sentences.en: tinyletter.com
sentences.zh: tinyletter.com

sentences.en: You can find the show and like the show on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 你可以在Facebook上找到并点赞我们的节目。

sentences.en: I tweet at Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我的推特账号是Roman Mars。

sentences.en: You can always catch up with us and look at more weapons in the arsenal of exclusion
sentences.zh: 你随时可以关注我们，查看更多“排斥武器库”中的内容，

sentences.en: at 99percentinvisible.org.
sentences.zh: 网址是99percentinvisible.org。
